scope: v1 completion-scoped grant design contracts; no runtime conformance result

cases.scenario: Reject empty, missing, cyclic, or otherwise invalid graph definitions.
Block an exchange before every dependency succeeds.
Reject a changed node definition under the same graph idempotency key.
Reject graph-wide credential, scope, audience, or DPoP binding.
Reject assertion reuse or a substituted node action, audience, scope, or JKT.
Reject batch approval or an approval view missing the resolved node binding.
Race cancellation with approval and consume; allow exactly one coordinator winner.
Block downstream work after partial failure or expiry; require a new graph to retry.
Reject missing or forged terminal evidence and redact secret-bearing evidence.
Reject mixed-audience graph sequencing; require the cross-resource coordination profile.
Reject approval of a node absent from the immutable graph; do not infer a node or mint a grant.
Bind an exchange to one approved graph node and reject substituted node action, audience, scope, JKT, or reuse bound.
Reject graph selector composition with coordination, standing-profile, or queue selectors before issuing any grant or receipt.
Reject wildcard, alias, duplicate, or dynamically added resource legs.
Reject implicit scope inheritance or a resource leg outside its trusted limit.
Require an immutable full-plan approval digest and reject mutation after display.
Reject a successor consume before a trusted predecessor success outcome.
Deduplicate parallel consumes and resource outcomes.
Reject forged or replayed resource outcome receipts.
Cancel all unconsumed legs after failure, expiry, or revocation and preserve partial evidence.
Keep a created or approved coordination parent non-authorizing and capability-free.
Reject an unknown coordination parent without inferring a plan or minting a child.
Mint exactly one bound one-use child only for the ready ordinal, and cap its expiry at the earlier parent and v0 limits.
Reject missing, wrong-audience, wrong-JKT, or replayed completion receipts.
Reject malformed terminal envelopes before durable enqueue.
Reject queue evidence or observability that contains a credential, proof, assertion, or raw result.
Replay an identical dedupe key and payload as one item; reject a changed payload.
Recover a retry after coordinator restart without changing immutable payload data.
Bound retry attempts and retention; expose exhausted work as a dead-letter item.
Record late delivery without reopening an expired or revoked grant or duplicating fan-out.
Reject an expired completion receipt before delivery or evidence mutation.
Keep an unknown local queue item local and never send a broker delivery.
Reject a requeue of broker-accepted, expired, or cancelled local work; only a valid dead letter can requeue.
Reject an invalid-signature completion receipt before any evidence mutation.
Issue a queue receipt only for an opt-in with a distinct completion DPoP JKT.
Dead-letter after restart without the original protected completion key; never substitute a key or send to the broker.
Reject a queue selector combined with a coordination or standing-profile selector before issuing a queue receipt or grant.
Validate allow, approval-pending, and blocked exchange envelopes.
Replay a canonical request and reject an idempotency-key collision with changed input.
Validate trusted approval retry and stable result serialization.
Validate valid one-use consume and all stable error/status mappings.
Reject DPoP replay, key mismatch, action mismatch, and token-hash mismatch.
Exercise DPoP clock-skew and grant-expiry boundaries with a deterministic clock.
Verify completion is idempotent and transient availability is the only retryable stable code.
Verify public JWK output and fixtures have no private key material.
Reject reusable profile fields on the retained v0 POST /exchange proposal surface.
Reject reusable authority unless an explicit versioned profile policy approves it.
Race consumes at the final use and allow exactly the configured number of successes.
Reject action, audience, scope, JKT, proof-token, TTL, and counter substitution.
Reject a replayed proof after restart or proof use with another credential.
Require explicit bounded renewal and preserve the resolved profile envelope.
Preserve terminal redacted evidence after standing-profile revocation or expiry.
Reject reuse combined with cross-resource coordination.
Downgrade only by issuing a fresh restricted one-use grant; never mutate a standing grant in place.
